title: Personal Checking: opening requirements for each tier
content:
## Scope

This quick reference covers the entry requirements of the six tiers of the Piedmont Crescent Bank (PCB) Personal Checking product: the smallest first deposit that funds and activates a new account, the Relationship Balance the customer must already hold on the opening date, the youngest and oldest age at which the customer may open the tier, and the most open accounts of that tier one customer may hold as primary owner.

## Entry requirements by tier

| Tier | Minimum opening deposit (USD) | Relationship Balance required on the opening date (USD) | Youngest age to open (whole years) | Oldest age to open (whole years) | Most open accounts of this tier per customer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 25.00 | 0.00 (no requirement) | 18 | No maximum | 1 |
| Student Checking | 25.00 | 0.00 (no requirement) | 17 | 24 | 1 |
| Everyday Checking | 50.00 | 0.00 (no requirement) | 18 | No maximum | 4 |
| Interest Checking | 100.00 | 0.00 (no requirement) | 18 | No maximum | 4 |
| Premier Checking | 100.00 | 0.00 (no requirement) | 18 | No maximum | 2 |
| Private Client Checking | 100.00 | 250000.00 | 18 | No maximum | 2 |

Reading the columns:

- **Minimum opening deposit**: the smallest first deposit that funds and activates a new account of the tier.
- **Relationship Balance required**: the Relationship Balance the customer must already hold on the opening date; a figure of 0.00 means the tier has no relationship requirement.
- **Youngest age**: the youngest age, in whole years on the opening date, at which the customer may open the tier as sole owner.
- **Oldest age**: the oldest age, in whole years on the opening date, at which the customer may open the tier; "No maximum" means the tier sets no upper age.
- **Most open accounts of this tier**: the most open accounts of that particular tier one customer may hold as primary owner.

## Which tests make up each tier's entry gate

| Tier | Age at least the youngest age | Age no more than the oldest age | First deposit at least the minimum | Relationship Balance at least the requirement | Accounts of this tier held below the tier maximum |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | Yes | — | Yes | — | Yes |
| Student Checking | Yes | Yes | Yes | — | Yes |
| Everyday Checking | Yes | — | Yes | — | Yes |
| Interest Checking | Yes | — | Yes | — | Yes |
| Premier Checking | Yes | — | Yes | — | Yes |
| Private Client Checking | Yes | — | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Points of judgement (derived from the tables above)

- **Which tier accepts the youngest owner?** Student Checking, whose youngest age is 17; every other tier requires 18.
- **Which tier has an upper age?** Only Student Checking, at 24. A customer who is 25 on the opening date is past that tier's oldest age.
- **Which tier asks for a Relationship Balance at opening?** Only Private Client Checking, at 250000.00 USD; for every other tier the figure is 0.00.
- **Hypothetical case**: a customer already holds one open Access Checking account as primary owner. Because the Access Checking maximum is 1, that customer is already at the tier maximum for Access Checking; the Everyday Checking maximum of 4 is a separate count for that other tier.
